reviews.text: Our cat was getting big dreads so we brought her for her first grooming experience to A 4 PATTES we have to admit we were a little stressed because she is not your cuddly-sit in your lap-let you rub and brush her type of cat , but everything went so very well. Agathe the groomer was very gentle, patient, and kind; she knew how to put her at ease. You can tell she loves animals and does her job with great professionalism. We highly recommend Agathe. Thank you again

Whenever I come to Paris to see my family, I always make a quick stop at this shop. The team is very friendly and welcoming, always attentive to my needs, and especially to those of my little one, who's a 15-year-old grandpa. They also have very nice coats and excellent quality natural products. Thank you, Mélanie, for always taking such good care of me. See you soon!
Thank you so much for these 5 stars! 🐾 We look forward to seeing you again very soon at À 4 PATTES! ❤️ …

I ordered two items from the website, they were shipped immediately and arrived quickly, with two bonus gifts and a humorous personalized note. They have a particularly wide selection of plush toys, with detailed descriptions that demonstrate a real knowledge of dogs and dog training. A very positive experience that I'll definitely repeat!
I came in to have my kitten's claws trimmed, and the person who did it was very gentle. I'm delighted with the service and the friendliness of the staff. 🫶 …

Excellent pet shop. I come regularly for my dog ​​and cat's food, and the staff always knows how to help me, even with very specific requests. The welcome is warm and the advice is relevant. I highly recommend it!

I used to go there occasionally before I got my little dog because I thought this shop was fantastic, but now that I finally have a puppy, I'm so happy to be able to buy things for her here.
The advice is always tailored to my needs, the welcome my little one receives is always wonderful, and the product range is extensive, meaning you can always find what you need, and the quality is always there.

I came with Cannelle, my little Chihuahua, and honestly, the welcome was fantastic! They took the time to look after her properly and advise me on what was best for her. Cannelle felt comfortable right away. I highly recommend it, I'll be back! Plus, she loved their dog dessert 🧁 …

A great experience! The store was clean, the staff were friendly and helpful, and they gave excellent advice for dogs and cats. My cat loves their Lily's Kitchen pâtés!

The dog wash service was super convenient! My Shih Tzu got a nice bath without me straining my back! Plus, the price was really reasonable considering all the necessary equipment and care.
We came in for a cat grooming appointment, and Agathe was incredibly gentle and efficient! We were delighted with the service, thank you again!
Very friendly welcome, diverse range of products and services 👍 …

A shameful grooming service, no hygiene whatsoever, and no safety for your pet!

I made an appointment to have my Persian cat groomed. Upon arrival, the previous client was already causing a scene because her poodle had been completely shaved without her consent... The groomer was having a full-blown nervous breakdown when she worked on my cat. She hadn't cleaned her hands or the tools she'd used beforehand, and the room was full of urine and dog hair. She was pulling out his fur by hand, screaming in a high-pitched voice; she sounded like a madwoman. There were no quiet clippers, and nothing to protect the cat's ears. He was terrified and fell off the table twice, into the dog urine on the floor. I asked to leave after 5 minutes. The owner said nothing, and they had the nerve to ask me to pay for the service, in addition to the deposit. I live in the neighborhood, and I strongly advise everyone against going there; they are not professionals!
Sunny was very well groomed. Agathe listened carefully to my requests, and all the staff were attentive and had huge smiles. I highly recommend bringing your pets to them (Ana Franchart and Sunny).
Perfect dog wash. Otherwise, everything for dogs. See you soon!
Such helpful and nice staff 💓 …
Very friendly and competent. Happy to translate and help a dog that got scared on holiday.

I'm not in Paris, but I ordered from the website...perfect! Plus, a little note for my daughter who loved it, and a very happy dog ​​with his new toys...I recommend this shop. Shipping was quite fast...thank you, you're wonderful!

A lovely little shop with everything you need for dogs and cats. The staff are very friendly and helpful. The prices are very reasonable and the quality is excellent, especially the selection of treats. It's not supermarket quality, and the team is genuinely dedicated to providing good things for our furry friends. Thank you to the team, and I look forward to seeing you again when I return to Paris!

The best pet store in the area! They have everything you need in terms of quality, all at very reasonable prices. The dog wash is super convenient for easily washing your dog. The welcome is warm and you feel very comfortable there. Thank you to the sales assistant Mélanie for her kindness and helpful advice; it's always a pleasure to shop in the store.

I received a very warm welcome and left my Siberian cat there for a thorough dematting during this period of intense heat. Everything went well, the work was done very well, and it required patience. Thank you so much to the groomer. My cat came home feeling calm and relaxed. Furthermore, the shop is very nice and air-conditioned, with a wide selection. I highly recommend it!

Hello,

I wanted to send you a quick note to thank you. You're a fantastic team of groomers, very friendly, and Venom came out perfectly clean.

I'll definitely be back very often.

Thanks again and see you soon,

My Maine Coon cat had her first grooming experience, and I'm absolutely delighted! I was a little stressed because it was her first time, but everything went very well. The groomer was very gentle, patient, and kind; she took the time to put her at ease. You can tell she loves animals and does her job with great professionalism. She came out looking beautiful, and I'm very happy with the result. I highly recommend her, and I'll gladly go back. Thank you again!

I took my little poodle mix to be groomed here for the first time and I'm thrilled!

My dog ​​was abandoned, and the first time I took him somewhere else, it didn't go well…
The groomer is kind, pleasant, and very gentle—everything you need to care for your furry friends.
She respected my request for a haircut and took care of my little dog with gentleness and professionalism. I recommend her 100%!
Nice place, good service, gentle people

A wide range of dog toys (many brands available and great deals depending on the time of year), unique treats (pouches, bulk, dog chocolates…), mats, beds, accessories like leashes, bandanas, etc. A loyalty program is available. A handy neighborhood shop that's perfect if you're missing something. Good customer service!

I took my Pomeranian, Loulou, to the groomer; he has alopecia, and the groomer understood perfectly. He came home looking fantastic! The service was perfect; I highly recommend them. A warm welcome and a great selection of treats, accessories, etc. Thanks again, I'll be back! 😁 …

My cat's grooming went wonderfully.
My cat is so happy to be lighter and more comfortable in this heatwave.
Thank you so much, madam.
Kaya had a great experience, the groomer took excellent care of her! I highly recommend it.

I've always received a very warm welcome at the shop, and my dog ​​loves their treats 🍭
I highly recommend it! And the location is perfect, right next to the park. …
I regularly visit with my dog ​​and my little boarders. I'm always warmly welcomed and given helpful advice. And they're delighted to receive treats and cuddles.
Fantastic shop! The team is very welcoming, professional, and always offers great advice. You can tell they love animals and take the time to help customers. I highly recommend it!
A huge thank you to the team at À 4 Pattes, who prepared my order with great care. My furry friend thanks you too! 🐾🤍 …
Very nice shop. Large selection. Friendly welcome. Grooming and dog wash services available.

So I wanted to thank Eve honestly, she's the best groomer I've ever met. She took care of my princess Khyrha like no one ever has. Honestly, if you go to the Four Paws groomer, ask for Eve, and thank you to the whole Four Paws team ❤️
Eve was fantastic as always. My puppy stayed calm with her the whole time. She took care of every detail with great patience. Highly recommended.
Thank you so much for these 5 stars! 🐾 See you soon at À 4 PATTES! ❤️ …
I just had my Staffordshire Bull Terrier puppy groomed, it was great. I recommend her 1000%, don't hesitate.
Amazing shop with amazing concepts… Puppy lattes!!! The team is lovely! They don't hesitate to organize (free) events, and the groomer is wonderful; it's so pleasant to be welcomed so warmly!!!

I took my dog ​​here to be groomed and I'm absolutely delighted with the experience! Eve, a very friendly person, took care of him with great gentleness and professionalism. You can tell she loves animals and takes the time to do things properly. My dog ​​came out looking beautiful and, most importantly, very relaxed. I'm very happy with the service and I'll definitely be back. Thank you again!
My dog ​​looked amazing after her grooming by Eve, who was very gentle and professional.
Eve made my dog ​​look so handsome!
The staff are amazing, especially young Eve who takes perfect care of my cat. I highly recommend them.

This lovely pet shop has a helpful and friendly staff. They have a great selection of food, treats, toys, accessories, cleaning products, and much more… plus a photo booth (photos printed on-site) and even a Puppuccino for your furry friend!

Also, Eve did a fantastic job grooming my dog! She was gentle, caring, and delicate… he was absolutely shiny after his trim and bath. Exceptional service; we'll definitely be back!
Hello, we're sorry to hear that your experience didn't meet your expectations. Please don't hesitate to contact us to tell us more. Have a good day, The Four-Legged Team.
Excellent welcome, service, and products. I go there once a month to have my cat's claws trimmed; she lets Eve do it, as she is gentle and very friendly with animals, and I thank her for her advice.

Very welcoming, with all the latest products and treats. But I especially recommend the grooming. Eve is simply amazing and very caring. She listens to all kinds of feedback and, above all, is a true animal lover, and it shows!
A very nice store with impeccable service.

A thousand thanks again to Eve who, as usual, pampered my little Hermes. She always goes the extra mile, takes her time, is gentle, and gives excellent advice. You can entrust your little baby to her without hesitation! 🥰🥰🥰🫶🏼 …

I used their dog wash service, and it was quite good. I have an Australian Shepherd with very thick fur, so it needs to be thoroughly wetted before washing.

Normally, I wash him first with a shampoo for white coats and then with a regular shampoo. There was a slight problem, though: I could only wash him with the shampoo for white coats because I hadn't even finished rinsing him before the hot water ran out.

I mentioned this to the shop owner, as well as pointing out that the shower hose is too short. Otherwise, everything was fine, the staff was friendly, and the shop had plenty of choices. Lucky was delighted.
I had my dog ​​groomed here, and it went very well. The groomer took her time with my dog; she was kind and very professional. I'm delighted and I recommend you check out this grooming salon.
Thank you Eve, you were perfect with my little Assya for her first grooming session and gave great advice. (Cat)
The shop is absolutely gorgeous!

This shop is excellent…it's a real treasure trove for dogs…you can find everything there and they take particularly good care of your pooch during grooming.
I highly recommend it 😊😊😊😊 …

Excellent experience at A 4 Pattes!

I received a very warm welcome, the staff were very attentive and offered great advice. The products are high quality, with a good selection. I highly recommend them!

I just left this shop shocked by the attitude of the young saleswoman. Having bought some cans of cat food, I asked for advice on toys. I explained my request: "My 14-year-old cat wants to play with me all the time. What do you suggest?" She replied, very confidently, "Oh, well, cats live to be 14 years old. He just wants your attention because these are his last moments of life..." Well, no, actually, a healthy cat can live up to 16, 18, or 20. Such behavior is unacceptable. I only came to buy a toy, and I left very, very angry. Fully aware of her stupidity. She apologized profusely.
And I definitely do not recommend this shop, which seems to have forgotten why they are in this business.
Fantastic experience with Eve who took such good care of my 4-month-old puppy! A very positive first experience. Thank you :)

A good selection, nice products, but they come at a price. The staff's approach isn't always in line with what you'd expect from a local shop. Advice was given behind the counter, but at no point was I helped to the products, even though I had lots of questions... I've lost faith in La Réserve Animale, and I regret it.

The shop is absolutely gorgeous and bright; I easily found everything I needed for my cats, and the staff were very helpful if we didn't find what we were looking for right away.

Plus, they carry high-quality brands that aren't always easy to find in stores.
Eve gave my Pomeranian a fantastic grooming job!!! 😍😍😍 I highly recommend her!!! Affordable prices …

I had my dog ​​groomed here and I was absolutely delighted! The groomer took such good care of my dog, with great care and gentleness. The cut was perfect, and my dog ​​looked so happy! I highly recommend them!
I was able to bring my girlfriend's dog home, and when I picked him up, the grooming was done extremely well by Eve. So I recommended her to other people I know.
Thank you to young Eve who made my little furball so soft
Great salon and thank you to Eve for pampering my dog.
Thank you to the best groomer! Eve!!! Professional and lovely...
The best dog shop in Paris with the most choice and impeccable customer service.
Great shop and good advice. Thank you for your welcome.

Fast and careful shipping. The cats are delighted with their toys.
Thank you for the extra gifts.
See you soon for another order.

We placed another order on the website. We live in the south of France. And just like the first time, the order was exactly as we expected and we received it very quickly. Thank you for your efficiency, your attentiveness, and your friendly manner on the phone.
A super stylish shop with lots of accessories for dogs and cats. They even have everything you need to groom your pet yourself or have it done professionally. I recommend it 100%!
A very lovely shop! Passing through Paris, it was recommended to me, and I was able to find something to please my niece and a friend for her dog. The advice I received was excellent.
We found loads of lovely treats and goodies for our cat in this beautifully decorated bottle! + The manager is very helpful!
Avoid this establishment and the worn-out toilet, Clemence, which shows a preference for dogs.
Refusal to take in a dog for the simple reason that one prefers clippers to excessively expensive hair removal.

It's true that sometimes when you walk in, you feel like you're intruding on a wake. The place is meant to be warm and welcoming, but it isn't.
What a shame, we were really looking forward to opening this shop!
Adorable
Professionalism, good products at the right price, competent and warm welcome and service.

A truly deplorable experience. The prices are exorbitantly high for products and services that are absolutely not worth the cost. The welcome is cold, you feel like you're bothering them. Nothing is displayed properly, and the quality frankly leaves much to be desired. I strongly advise against this place: a guaranteed waste of time and money.
Exorbitant prices, bad advice, and a regrettable experience; I do not recommend it.

I had my two Akita Inus groomed at À 4 Pattes and I'm absolutely delighted with the result! Clémence was incredibly patient with them, very gentle and professional. My dogs came out clean, well-groomed, and relaxed. I highly recommend this shop for the quality of service and the warm welcome. Thank you again! 🐾✨ …
Thank you so much for these 5 stars! 🐾 We look forward to seeing you again at À 4 PATTES! ❤️ …
Thank you so much for these 5 stars! 🐾 We look forward to seeing you again at À 4 PATTES! ❤️ …

We always go to this charming shop to buy everything we need for our little cat, Sacha.

The welcome is warm, the advice is always helpful, and the products are of high quality. You can tell that animals are truly at the heart of everything they do. Thank you for your kindness! 😻

Just a pet supply store...
Don't entrust your pets to this grooming salon, or rather, this salon of incompetents.

1 star – Shameful experience: incompetent, disrespectful, and dangerous for dogs
I came to this salon to have my long-haired German Shepherd groomed, with clear instructions: a scissor cut only, adapted to his double coat. Nothing extraordinary, just what a professional is supposed to know how to do.

And yet, they clipped him all over with clippers, without calling me, without warning me, and without my consent. The result is not only a disaster, but dangerous for his health.

➡️ This type of clipping is strongly discouraged for a dog like mine. The long-haired German Shepherd has a double coat designed to protect against heat, cold, and UV rays. Clipping him like that irreparably damages his fur, disrupts regrowth, and makes him vulnerable to sunburn, parasites, and irritations.

And the worst part? When I expressed my dissatisfaction, the manager literally laughed in my face. No explanation, no apology. As if I were wrong to be indignant about their own mistake.

And of course, I was still asked to pay €65 for a butchery I never authorized. It's a disgrace.

And I'm not even mentioning the botched result: harsh lines, an uneven cut, and even the paws weren't done properly. There are still clumps of hair that weren't shaved properly in places. A real amateur job, done in a rush.

The irony is that I know more about my dog's breed's coat than the people who are supposed to be "professionals."

This salon has no understanding of breed-specific needs, nor of customer service.

📸 Before/after photos attached. Judge for yourself. What I asked for vs. what I got.

➡️ If you love your dog, stay away from this place. Lack of competence, lack of respect, and above all: no sense of responsibility. I would not recommend anyone entrust their pet to them.

I so wanted to leave a good review, but unfortunately I can't. Your groomer completely shaved my medium-haired German Shepherd; it's a disaster! YOU DON'T SHAVE DOUBLE-COATED DOGS! Something we didn't ask for! You can trim the coat with scissors ✂️, but never shave it. It's a matter of the dog's health. Do your research before doing something irreparable!
As long as you have your ignorant groomer working for you, you won't see me again!

Thank you anyway for the gesture of goodwill, which doesn't make up for the damage.
Great selection of items, personalized advice. A huge thank you to the groomer: she trimmed my cat's claws, and I've never seen him so well-behaved and relaxed!
A very nice pet shop with everything you need for dogs and cats 😊 They even have coffee for the owners. …
We took our young dog in, but the groomer wouldn't take her because she was too young; she's only 6 months old. The groomer is incompetent!
A superb place for our four-legged loves; my Tigrou was able to have his nails trimmed with complete confidence.
A perfect place for dogs and their human companions!

Excellent store! The staff are very friendly, helpful, and offer great advice. The shop is beautiful, well laid out, and easy to navigate.

A dog wash is available, with all the necessary products: shampoo, brushes, and products for eyes, ears, and paws.

A groomer is also on-site, who is very kind and attentive.

A nice bonus: you can enjoy a coffee while your furry friend enjoys a delicious puppy latte!

In short: a quality store with a wide selection of products. The staff is attentive, passionate, and responsive. We will definitely be back!
First time our dog has left a groomer smelling really good, with a well-done and affordable haircut! Great selection of products!
Thanks for the stars :)
Thank you for your feedback!

We are delighted with Apfel's raincoat. Frankly, after a walk in the rain and storm, we could really appreciate how effective the raincoat was and how well it protected his belly, the area that gets the dirtiest. When we got back, we only had his paws and head to dry. I must say, the towel we bought from the shop with the raincoat really absorbed the water from his paws and head.

An excellent experience that we wanted to share.
Christine and Apfel the Eurasier

I read excellent reviews about your shop… and after waiting a while in front of the closed shop, I was lucky enough to find a very friendly and helpful salesperson… They have a wide variety of good quality products for cats and dogs… I'll be back! 🐈🐈‍⬛ …
A very nice shop with an interesting selection and helpful advice.

A fantastic shop for our little four-legged friends.

They also groom small dogs. My little dog came out looking amazing.
I highly recommend it.

A superb grooming experience for my 4-year-old cocker spaniel. I asked for a fluffy puppy cut, and the result was impeccable… even though he had some knots! It's perhaps the best haircut he's ever had, from any groomer. Four hours of work for 140 euros, a very reasonable price. Furthermore, the welcome was exceptionally warm. The shop is also very inviting, and the products are of excellent quality.
I had my little toy poodle's first haircut there and I'm thrilled! Warm welcome <3 Super friendly team! And I'm very, very, very happy with the grooming <3 Thank you again, I'll be back :)

First of all, I'm delighted that this shop near the Buttes Chaumont park exists, and I'm very pleased with the quality of its service. I also want to highlight Clémence's work; she took the time to groom my dog ​​Rose very well. I'm extremely happy with the result and her expertise in grooming a Pomeranian! Thank you so much.

We love this store! You can find products there that you don't see anywhere else, and what's more, there are always new items depending on the season. At Christmas, we fell in love with the gingerbread plush and the Christmas bandana, and for Halloween, the spooky treats are fantastic!

(And lots of other things too, like raincoats, little bow ties, etc.)

Jam and Mathieu are super nice, always offer great advice, and always have a smile on their faces. And their dog, Kitaï, is just too cute!

Sasha gives a 100% thumbs up to the puppy latte (and the whole store, actually, even the dog wash). In short, we highly recommend it!

Passing by this lovely shop, I found them kind and attentive to my spaniel's needs...
Today...with delivery, it's perfect 👍 …
A new pet shop has opened in the 19th arrondissement, opposite the Buttes Chaumont park. Lots of choices, reasonable prices, and above all, a very friendly owner!
Thank you for your stars. See you soon!

Great shop! There's a lot of choice, and especially items you can't find anywhere else, which is a nice change ☺️
The service was excellent, and the loyalty program is a real bonus!
Thank you very much for your feedback. See you soon!
Thank you for the stars! See you very soon.
An incredibly beautiful store with a great selection! The manager was polite and pleasant. Thank you so much for carefully choosing a coat for my whippet.
Great place, the shop is beautiful. A wide variety of trendy items. And on top of that, the advice is excellent.
A really nice place for you and your dog. Drinks and treats for your furry friends, and drinks for humans too!
Thank you for the stars!
Thank you for your feedback. See you soon, on all fours!
Very cute new place with a great selection.

A lovely, well-located, and bright shop with a great selection and personalized advice.

Special mention to the photo booth, which allowed us to capture our visit with our furry friends.

See you soon!
